exposure: Congenital adrenal hyperplasia (CAH) due to 21-hydroxylase deficiency
outcome: visual working memory (Visual Memory Span score, number of hits, number recalled backward)
verbal memory (Free Recall, Total Free Recall)
cohort: The study included 39 individuals: female adolescents with CAH due to 21-hydroxylase deficiency, and age and pubertal stage matched healthy male and female controls.
finding: Female adolescents with CAH had worse visual working memory compared to matched controls, but not in verbal memory, and a later age at CAH diagnosis was negatively associated with memory test scores.
